mapper.sql: (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN h.type = 'IN' THEN h.qty ELSE -h.qty END), 0) FROM equipment_spare_part_history h WHERE h.spare_part_id = p.id)
mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, AS current_stock, CASE WHEN <= 0 THEN '재고없음' WHEN < p.safe_stock THEN '부족' ELSE '정상' END AS stock_status FROM equipment_spare_part p WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y'
AND p.equip_name = #{equipName}
AND p.part_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.equip_name ASC, p.part_name ASC
SELECT DISTINCT equip_name FROM equipment_spare_part WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND equip_name != '' ORDER BY equip_name
SELECT p.*, AS current_stock, CASE WHEN <= 0 THEN '재고없음' WHEN < p.safe_stock THEN '부족' ELSE '정상' END AS stock_status FROM equipment_spare_part p WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_spare_part (part_name, equip_name, standard, maker, unit, safe_stock, replace_type, buy_cycle, storage_location, rack_no, remark, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{partName}, #{equipName}, #{standard}, #{maker}, #{unit}, #{safeStock}, #{replaceType}, #{buyCycle}, #{storageLocation}, #{rackNo}, #{remark}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment_spare_part SET part_name = #{partName}, equip_name = #{equipName}, standard = #{standard}, maker = #{maker}, unit = #{unit}, safe_stock = #{safeStock}, replace_type = #{replaceType}, buy_cycle = #{buyCycle}, storage_location = #{storageLocation}, rack_no = #{rackNo}, remark = #{remark}, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE equipment_spare_part SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT h.*, p.part_name FROM equipment_spare_part_history h JOIN equipment_spare_part p ON p.id = h.spare_part_id
AND h.spare_part_id = #{partId} AND h.type = #{type} AND h.reg_dt >= CONCAT(#{from}, ' 00:00:00') AND h.reg_dt <= CONCAT(#{to}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY h.reg_dt DESC, h.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_spare_part_history (spare_part_id, type, qty, work_desc, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{sparePartId}, #{type}, #{qty}, #{workDesc}, #{regUserName})
